pass_rule: State academies, university-linked, independent protocol and international training bodies tested for structural advantage/disadvantage unrelated to intended quality constructs.
interpretation_rule: Synthetic invariance proves only that forbidden contextual proxies are not in the computational formula. G08 still requires real edge-case review for structural evidence availability, mission differences and indicator applicability.
blockers_to_start: No frozen Pilot 20 with all four peer types is available.
No real small-specialist versus large state/university edge-case review exists.
No real peer-type missingness and indicator-applicability analysis exists.
No authorised human fairness review has occurred.
human_gate: Software may detect score differences and proxy leakage; only authorised methodological review may determine whether an indicator structurally advantages or disadvantages a peer type.
